title: MyPage
subtitle: Homepage Builder
error_locked: Too many failed attempts. Please wait 15 minutes.
twofa_login_hint: Code from your authenticator app or a backup code.
adminpw_hint: Username and password for signing in to the admin panel. Only a hash is stored — the password itself is never written to disk.
adminpw_hint_initial: The password generated at first start is still in use. It was written to the container log. Please set your own now.
adminpw_on_ha: On Home Assistant, username and password live in the add-on options: Settings → Add-ons → MyPage → Configuration. Nothing to set here.
adminpw_code: Code from your two-factor app (or a backup code)
adminpw_rule: At least {n} characters, including at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter and one digit.
adminpw_forgot: Forgot the password? Delete admin_login.json in the data folder and restart the container — MyPage then generates a new password and writes it to the log. Content, members and settings are left untouched.
adminpw_mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
adminpw_err_auth: Current password or code is wrong.
adminpw_err_locked: Too many failed attempts. Please wait 5 minutes.
adminpw_err_pw_too_short: The new password is too short.
adminpw_err_pw_no_upper: The new password needs an uppercase letter.
adminpw_err_pw_no_lower: The new password needs a lowercase letter.
adminpw_err_pw_no_digit: The new password needs a digit.
adminpw_err_bad_username: Username: 3 to 64 characters; letters, digits and . _ - @ are allowed.
adminpw_err_on_ha: On Home Assistant the access data is managed in the add-on options.
log_hint: The most recent warnings and errors of the running add-on — the same messages that otherwise only appear in the Home Assistant add-on log. The last 300 lines from level “warning” up are kept; repeats of the same line raise a counter instead of filling the list. For looking things up only: whatever is here has already happened. The full log including informational lines is in Home Assistant under Settings → Add-ons → MyPage → Log.
log_hint_docker: The most recent warnings and errors of the running container. The last 300 lines from level “warning” up are kept; repeats of the same line raise a counter instead of filling the list. For looking things up only: whatever is here has already happened. The full log including informational lines comes from `docker compose logs`.
log_clear_confirm: Discard the lines shown here? The log in Home Assistant is not affected.
log_clear_confirm_docker: Discard the lines shown here? The container's own log is left untouched.
log_only_warnings: Warnings only, no errors — untick the box to see them.
health_public_url_hint: Without it the sitemap, RSS feed and canonical addresses point into your local network. Set it on the Design tab under “Search engines” as “Public URL”.
health_client_ip_hint: The proxy does not pass the visitor's address through — visitor log and country stats stay empty. Set X-Forwarded-For in the proxy.
health_backup_hint: The newest backup is more than a day old, or there is none. Check the retention setting in the add-on options.
health_disk_hint: When space runs short, backups, image uploads and PDF generation fail — usually silently. Clean up or keep fewer backups.
health_storage_hint: Overall limit for the data folder (images, PDFs, member files, backups), set by the operator. Once reached, new uploads are rejected; browsing, deleting and cleaning up keep working. Not changeable in the admin panel — it lives in the add-on configuration or the compose.yaml.
diskuse_hint: What the data folder holds, broken down by area. The figures are counted fresh when you open this. An overall limit is set by the operator in the add-on configuration or the compose.yaml (MYPAGE_STORAGE_MAX_MB) — deliberately not changeable here.
diskuse_total_limit: {used} of {limit} used ({pct} %). Once the limit is reached, new uploads are rejected — browsing, deleting and cleaning up keep working.
diskuse_total_nolimit: {used} used, no limit set. The disk still has {free} free.
diskuse_smb_note: Member files live on an SMB share and therefore do not count towards this.
health_smtp_hint: The last send failed. Affects the contact form, newsletter, registration and password reset.
health_github_hint: The star update was rejected — the token has expired or lacks permissions. Projects keep showing the last known numbers.
health_pillow_hint: Pillow is missing — uploaded images are neither resized nor stripped of metadata.
health_weasy_hint: WeasyPrint is missing although library entries are set to generate their PDF.
health_geoip_hint: The country list is old. Newly assigned address ranges will not map to a country.
twofa_hint: Adds a one-time code from an authenticator app to the direct login (port 17761). When accessing via Home Assistant (ingress), 2FA is not required — HA already authenticates you there.
twofa_hint_docker: Protects the login with an additional one-time code from an authenticator app. Without Home Assistant this login is the only way into the admin panel — so keep the backup codes somewhere safe.
twofa_scan_hint: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password) or enter the secret manually. Then confirm with a current code.
twofa_codes_hint: Keep these backup codes safe — each works exactly once if you lose access to the app. They are shown only now.
twofa_prompt_code: To confirm, please enter a current 2FA code (or a backup code):
set_intro_ha: MyPage manages these settings itself and stores them in settings.json in the data folder — tokens and passwords encrypted. The Home Assistant add-on options now only hold username, password and session length as an emergency login.
set_intro_docker: MyPage stores these settings in settings.json in the data folder — tokens and passwords encrypted. Username, password and session length still come from options.json.
set_crypto_warn: Encryption unavailable — secret fields cannot be saved.
set_secret_keep_hint: Tokens and passwords are never sent back. An empty field means “leave unchanged”; use the delete button to remove one.
set_secret_clear_confirm: Remove this credential on the next save?
set_saved_restart: Saved. The add-on needs one restart before the SMB storage takes effect.
set_mail_hint: For contact notifications, newsletters and member mails.
set_notify_hint: Alerts for new messages, comments and system events.
set_services_hint: Credentials for the GitHub project import and translation.
set_translate_email: E-mail for the MyMemory translation quota
set_ai_hint: Without an API key the AI features stay hidden. Usage is billed by Google.
set_files_hint: Size limit per file uploaded in the member area.
set_smb_hint: Optional SMB storage for member files. Changes apply immediately if a share was already set up at start — otherwise only after an add-on restart.
set_visits_hint: Size of the visitor log and retention of the archive.
set_visit_file_log: Also archive visits as monthly files
set_geoip_offline: Resolve countries offline from the local IP table
set_visit_bot_nets_hint: One network per line, e.g. 203.0.113.0/24. Matches count as datacenter traffic, not as visitors.
set_backup_hint: How many automatic backups are kept.
set_csp_hint: They tell the browser up front what a page is allowed to do: scripts only from this server, no camera, no location, no embedding into other sites. Should foreign code ever be smuggled into a piece of content — through an imported GitHub README, say — the browser will not run it.
set_csp_note: “Report only” sends the policy but blocks nothing: the browser logs to its console (F12) what it would have blocked. Leave it like that for a while, check the console on your site and in the admin — if nothing shows up, switch to “Enforce”. The other headers (Permissions-Policy, nosniff, Referrer-Policy) are always active.
set_revisions_hint: Before every change MyPage stores a copy of the site content (tab System → Earlier versions). Each copy holds the complete state of the site's structure and content — including the module switches. 0 turns the safety net off. Individual versions can be kept with 📌 on the System tab — those stay no matter how small this number is.
set_key_hint: The key decrypts every stored credential and is deliberately NOT part of the backup. So that restoring onto a fresh installation still works, you can download it separately here — wrapped with a passphrase only you know. Without that passphrase the file is worthless, so it may sit right next to the backup.
set_key_state_no: No key yet — one is created as soon as you save the first password or token.
set_key_pass_hint: At least 10 characters. Never stored anywhere — lose it and the export is worthless.
set_key_overwrite_confirm: A different key is already in place and stored credentials are encrypted with it. Replacing it makes those credentials permanently unreadable. Continue anyway?
set_key_err_locked: Too many failed attempts. Please wait 5 minutes.
set_key_err_wrong_passphrase: Wrong passphrase — the file cannot be opened.
set_key_err_invalid: That is not a valid key file.
set_key_err_no_key: There is no key to back up yet.
users_hint: Each user gets their own password-protected file area at /bereich. The username is the email address. If a mail server is configured, the user automatically receives their credentials by email.
user_pw_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
user_pw_mailed: Password changed — user was notified by email
user_created_mailed: User created — credentials sent by email
user_delete_confirm: Really delete user {email} and all their files?
user_smtp_off: Welcome email: no mail server configured
user_no_url_warn: User created, but: the public URL is missing in the Design tab — the email therefore contains no login link!
registration_enabled_hint: Visitors can create an account themselves (email confirmation + your approval required). Requires SMTP and a public URL.
user_resend_confirm: Resend credentials to {email}? A NEW password will be generated — the old one will no longer work.
user_resent: New password generated and credentials sent
login_msg_hint: Shown to the user after signing in to their personal area (Markdown supported). Leave empty for no message.
welcome_from_hint: Optional alias sender (e.g. noreply@…) specifically for welcome and password emails. Must be configured as an allowed alias on the mailbox. Empty = default sender from the add-on options.
welcome_from_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
storage_hint: Choose the subfolder on the storage (e.g. SMB share) where user folders should live. Existing files are not moved automatically.
storage_down_admin: The SMB storage is currently unreachable — user files are temporarily offline. The connection is restored automatically (checked every minute).
member_err_storage: The website’s storage is full — the file was not saved. Please let the operator know.
member_no_files: No files yet — upload your first one.
member_err_quota: Storage limit reached — the file was not saved.
member_forgot_intro: Enter your email address. If an account exists, we'll send you a link to reset it.
member_reset_sent: If an account with this email exists, we've sent you a reset link. Please check your inbox.
member_reset_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
member_reset_short: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
member_pwchanged: Your password has been changed. Please sign in with the new password.
member_register_intro: Create an account. You'll receive a confirmation email; after that the operator approves your account.
member_register_sent: Almost done! If the details are valid, we've sent you a confirmation email. Please check your inbox (and spam folder).
member_register_email_err: Please enter a valid email address.
member_verify_ok: Thanks! Your email is confirmed. Once the operator approves your account, you can sign in.
member_verify_invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired.
member_login_unverified: Please confirm your email address first (link in the registration email).
member_login_pending: Your account is still awaiting approval by the operator.
member_profile_name_hint: Shown e.g. on blog comments. Empty = the part before the @ in your email.
member_profile_lang_hint: Which language you receive emails from this site in (e.g. reminders, password reset).
mail_welcome_intro: Hello, a personal file area has been set up for you on {title}.
mail_welcome_ignore: If you did not expect this account, you can ignore this email.
mail_reset_intro: A password reset was requested for your account at {title}.
mail_reset_cta: Click the following link to set a new password (valid for 1 hour):
mail_reset_ignore: If this wasn't you, simply ignore this email — your password stays unchanged.
mail_verify_intro: Welcome to {title}! Please confirm your email address to complete registration (link valid for 24 hours):
mail_verify_after: After that, the operator will activate your account — you will receive another email.
mail_verify_ignore: If you didn't register, simply ignore this email.
mail_exists_intro: An account already exists for this email address at {title}.
mail_exists_login: You can sign in here: {base}/bereich
mail_exists_login_nourl: You can sign in to the members area.
mail_exists_forgot: Forgot your password? Use the "Forgot password?" link on the login page.
mail_exists_ignore: If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email.
mail_activated_intro: Your account at {title} has been activated — you can sign in now.
mail_dm_body: you have new unread messages in your inbox.
mail_dm_privacy: For privacy reasons no content is shown here — please check your inbox.
comments_empty: No comments yet — be the first.
comment_login_hint: Log in to react or comment.
comments_enabled_hint: Members can comment on blog posts and react with emoji.
share_enabled_hint: Shows share buttons below blog posts and project detail pages (WhatsApp, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, email, copy link). Plain links only — no tracking, nothing loaded.
dm_enabled_hint: Members can send each other private messages. Texts are stored encrypted. Every member can turn off receiving in their own profile.
dm_ha_notify_hint: Sends you (the operator) a Home Assistant notification whenever a member receives a new message — no content, summarized per recipient. Only useful when the add-on runs under Home Assistant.
directory_enabled_hint: Members can (optionally) show themselves with an avatar and a short intro in an internal directory — so everyone knows who they're messaging. Each member controls their own visibility in their profile.
search_enabled_hint: Shows a search box in the header and searches blog posts, projects and pages. Members-only content appears to guests as title only, without a preview.
search_prompt: Enter a term to search posts, projects and pages.
search_locked_hint: Members only — please sign in to view this content.
dir_intro: Other members with avatar and short intro — find out who you can message.
dir_page_sub: Only members who chose to be visible.
dir_empty: Nobody has made themselves visible in the directory yet.
dir_avatar_err: Could not process the image. Allowed: PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF.
dir_visible_label: Show me in the member directory
dir_visible_hint: If this is off, other members see neither your avatar nor your intro.
user_dm_on_title: Message receiving on (click to turn off)
user_dm_off_title: Message receiving off (click to turn on)
dm_intro: Send private messages to other members. Texts are stored encrypted.
dm_receive_hint: If you turn this off, your name no longer appears in anyone's recipient list. Existing conversations stay visible.
dm_slow: One moment please – not so fast.
dm_thread_empty: No messages yet. Write the first one!
dm_partner_gone: This member no longer exists. Replying is not possible.
dm_att_err: Attachment rejected: too large (max. 25 MB) or unsupported file type.
dm_partner_off: This member is currently not receiving messages.
dm_off_err: This member is currently not receiving messages.
dm_no_recipients: No member is reachable right now.
dm_broadcast_note: This is an announcement – replying is not possible.
broadcast_hint: Writes an announcement into every member's inbox (encrypted). Members cannot reply to it. Requires member messages to be enabled.
broadcast_confirm: Really send this message to ALL members?
broadcast_dm_off: Please enable member messages in the Design tab first.
dm_delete_convo_confirm: Delete this entire conversation for you?
comments_mod_hint: Comments from members — you can remove them here.
post_tags_hint: Keywords, comma-separated (max. 8) — used for filtering and search in the blog.
blog_hint: Posts appear under /blog, the latest three also on the homepage. Markdown is supported.
pages_hint: Standalone pages (e.g. “About”, “Directions”) with their own address under /seite/…. Markdown supported; drag to reorder.
page_slug_auto: Leave empty → generated from the title.
members_only_notice: This content is only visible to logged-in members. Please log in to continue reading.
section_members_on: Visible to members only — click to make public
section_members_off: Visible to everyone — click: members only
forms_hint: Freely configurable forms (e.g. event sign-up, survey, request). Reachable at /formular/…; submissions appear in the “Messages” tab and trigger the usual notification. Drag to reorder.
form_fields_hint: Add fields via “+ Field”, drag the ⠿ handle to reorder. Options (for select/radio): one per line.
form_success_default: Thank you! Your submission has been sent.
form_err_captcha: The math answer was incorrect. Please try again.
form_err_rate: Too many submissions. Please try again later.
form_err_required: Please fill in all required fields.
post_schedule_hint: If set to "Published" with a future date, the post appears automatically from that day on.
entity_type_hint: Determines what search engines read from the page. “Local business” passes on address, opening hours and coordinates from the “Location” section — which needs entries there.
cta_hint: Up to two buttons in the header — the first one in the accent colour. Target: an anchor on the home page (e.g. “#kontakt”), your own address (“/seite/anfahrt”), an external address or “mailto:”.
hero_layout_hint: Centred suits a logo rather than a portrait. Banner image places a picture behind the header and darkens it so the text stays readable.
avatar_shape_hint: Round and rounded crop to a square — a wide logo loses its left and right edges. “Uncropped” keeps the aspect ratio.
hero_image_hint: Shown across the full width and darkened. A calm, wide picture works best.
post_seo_ph: Empty = auto-generated from the post text
post_seo_hint: Optional: description for Google/social. Leave empty → the first ~155 characters of the post are used automatically.
seo_desc_ph: Short and to the point, 1–2 sentences (max ~155 chars)
seo_desc_hint: The text Google shows under the title in search results. Empty = the tagline or “About me” is used. Recommended: 1–2 sentences about what the site is about.
allow_indexing_hint: Off = the site asks all search engines not to index it (noindex + robots.txt Disallow) and IndexNow pauses. Default: on.
mini_games_hint: Shows a “Mini Games” link in the footer: Snake, Dino, Pong, photo memory (uses your album images), a slot machine (777 jackpot), blackjack (17+4), video poker and a trick-question quiz. Default: off.
reveal_hint: Content appears animated on load and while scrolling. Anyone with “reduce motion” enabled in their system settings sees everything without animation. Default: off.
reveal_stagger_hint: Tiles/cards in a section appear slightly staggered one after another instead of all at once. Default: on.
md_img_url: Enter image URL — or leave empty to upload a file:
console_greet1: 👋 Hi! Curious how this site is built?
console_greet2: This site ({name}) runs on MyPage in Home Assistant. Try the Konami code 😉
g_cards_goal: Goal: get closer to 21 than the dealer without busting.
g_pk_goal: Video poker: a pair of Jacks or better wins.
g_quiz_final: Tip: the obvious answer is rarely the right one. 😉

Which number gets bigger when you turn it upside down?
What goes up and down but never moves from the spot?
What has many teeth but never bites?
What gets bigger the more you take away?
What has hands but cannot clap?
What has cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish?
What can you catch but not throw?
What has four wheels and flies?
What belongs to you but is used more by others than by you?

g66_intro: The classic trick-taking game against the AI — 20 cards, marriages, closing, going out. Your game is saved and can be continued on any device.
g66_close_confirm: Close the talon? You must then reach 66 points yourself, otherwise the AI wins.
g66_new_confirm: Give up the current match and start over?
g66_rules_std_desc: With calling: the first to reach 66 points ends the deal immediately.
g66_rules_oma_desc: No calling: always played to the end. Whoever has 66+ at the end wins — otherwise the last trick wins.
g66_level_easy_desc: Relaxed play — the AI makes more mistakes and plays carelessly.
g66_level_medium_desc: Balanced — the AI plays mostly solid but slips up occasionally.
g66_level_hard_desc: Full strength — the AI always plays its best strategy.
g66_level_adaptive_desc: Adjusts to you: win and the AI gets stronger; lose and it gets weaker.
g66_settings_hint: Applies from the next move. Saved in this browser.
g66_tab_text: You opened the game in another browser tab. This tab has been disconnected so the two don't interfere with each other. Your progress is safely saved.
easter_eggs_hint: Hidden fun for visitors: Konami code (↑↑↓↓←→←→ B A) → confetti + message, click the avatar 5× → secret tagline, type the word “matrixx” → code rain, greeting in the browser console. Default: off.
indexnow_hint: Automatically notifies Bing (and partners like DuckDuckGo/Ecosia) whenever you publish posts/projects — for faster indexing. Requires the public URL to be set. A key is generated automatically and hosted as a file under your domain. (Google does not use IndexNow.)
verify_hint: Optional. Only needed if you want to verify your site in Google Search Console or Bing via the “HTML tag” method. Enter the verification code (or paste the whole meta tag — the code is extracted automatically); MyPage then adds the matching meta tag to the homepage head. Leave empty if your site is already verified.
indexnow_need: Please enable IndexNow, set the public URL and save first.
faq_hint: Frequently asked questions & answers (collapsible on the homepage). Answers support Markdown.
support_hint: Optional link (e.g. Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi, PayPal, GitHub Sponsors) — shown as a button in the profile header. The icon is detected automatically.
custom_css_hint: Your own CSS rules for the public page. For advanced users — included as-is.
import_readme: Use the repos' README as detail text
cleanup_hint: Removes uploaded images that are no longer used in any post, page, project or album (e.g. after deleting a page). Only truly unused files are deleted.
cleanup_cache_note: Plus {n} file(s) from the image cache: watermarked or AI-labelled versions whose image is gone. They are rebuilt on demand.
nf_hint: Requests that went nowhere — grouped by address, most frequent first. The rows that matter carry the label “internal link”: there your own website points to an address that does not (or no longer) exist, for example after renaming a page. “Create redirect” puts the address into the list below, pre-filled; you add the target and save. After that the request no longer counts as an error. A “probe” is a request looking for other software (/xmlrpc.php, /.env, /api/graphql) — internet background noise, not a fault of yours, and therefore hidden by default.
nf_only_bots: Only bot and probe requests — clear the checkboxes to see them.
nf_redirect_added: Row added — enter the target and save.
nf_forget_confirm: Remove “{path}” from the list? New requests start counting from zero again.
nf_clear_confirm: Clear the whole list? New requests keep being recorded.
redirects_hint: Permanently (301) or temporarily (302) redirect old/changed addresses to a new one. Only applies to paths that don't (any longer) exist — existing pages are never overridden. Target as an internal path (/new-page) or a full URL (https://…).
redirects_target_hint: Typing in the target field suggests matching addresses from your site; the arrow lists them all. An external address (https://…) can still be typed.
export_hint: Downloads the whole site as a static HTML package (German) — e.g. for GitHub Pages. Contact form and language switcher are disabled in the export.
sensors_hint: The add-on automatically reports sensor.mypage_views_total, sensor.mypage_visitors_total, sensor.mypage_views_today and sensor.mypage_visitors_today to Home Assistant (every 2 minutes).
ghtoken_hint: Optional. Without a token GitHub allows only 60 requests per hour, with one 5,000. Required permissions: none for public repos (access »Public Repositories«), »Contents: Read-only« for private repos.
ghtoken_missing: No token configured — import and star updates run on 60 requests per hour.
ghtoken_invalid: Token invalid or expired — please renew it in the add-on settings.
ghtoken_expired: Expiry date is in the past.
nf_text: The requested page does not exist (anymore).
err_403_text: You don't have permission for this area. Please sign in or go back.
err_413_text: The uploaded file exceeds the allowed limit. Please reduce its size and try again.
err_500_text: An unexpected error occurred on the server. Please try again later.
skills_hint: Shown as chips on the page. Emojis work too: 🐍 Python
countdown_admin_hint: Visibly counts down to a date (e.g. opening, launch, event). The style adapts automatically to theme and accent color. Empty target date = section off.
countdown_notify_hint: Shows a button for visitors to leave their e-mail for the newsletter. Requires an active newsletter (Design tab) + SMTP + public URL.
timeline_title_hint: The heading above applies to the whole section — leave it empty for “Career”. Useful alternatives: “Our history”, “Milestones”, “Company history”, “Timeline”, “Project phases”.
links_hint: Links to other sites. A button appears on the homepage that opens an overview; a click opens the link in a new tab. URL must start with http:// or https://.
links_subtitle: A selection of sites and tools I recommend.
albums_hint: Images are automatically resized on upload (max. 1600 px, WebP). Clicking an album opens a slideshow.
album_protect_hint: Burns the watermark into all album and library images and disables right-click/dragging in the albums. Note: complete download protection is technically impossible on the web (screenshots always remain). Empty text field = “© your-domain.com”.
long_hint: With a detail text or gallery the project gets its own subpage, linked from the card.
contact_telegram_hint: Tip: get notified about new messages via Telegram (bot token + chat ID) or email (SMTP) — configurable in the add-on options.
contact_success: Thanks! Your message has been sent.
contact_error: Sending failed. Please try again later.
contact_rate_limited: Too many messages — please try again later.
contact_captcha_wrong: Security question answered incorrectly — please try again.
messages_hint: Messages from the public page's contact form (up to 200 are kept).
maintenance_hint: Takes the public page offline and shows a notice instead (HTTP 503). The admin panel stays available.
pvlink_hint: Creates an address that serves the real site — with navigation, subpages and everything the preview frame on the Design tab cannot do. Everyone else keeps seeing the maintenance page. Switched-off areas (blog, library, projects, travel blog, forms) are visible in it too, without turning them on for everyone. The link can be shared: a board member, client or partner can take a look before go-live without admin access.
preview_revoke_confirm: Invalidate every preview link issued so far, right now? Including the one you have open.
preview_valid_until: Valid until {until}. On first visit the browser remembers the preview; the address itself is no longer needed after that.
preview_no_public_url: Note: nothing is set under Design → Public URL, so the link points at the internal address and only works on the same network.
preview_bar: Preview — visitors see the maintenance page or the switched-off area.
maintenance_default: This site is currently under maintenance. Please check back later.
audit_hint: Security-relevant admin actions (login, users, settings, backup).
nl_confirmed: Thanks! Your newsletter subscription is confirmed.
nl_sent: Almost done! We've sent you an email — please confirm your subscription in it.
nl_unsubscribed: You have been unsubscribed from the newsletter.
nl_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired.
nl_invalidmail: Please enter a valid email address.
nl_box_intro: Get new posts and news by email. Unsubscribe anytime.
newsletter_enabled_hint: Visitors can subscribe to the newsletter on the blog page (double opt-in). Requires SMTP and a public URL.
nl_admin_hint: Write a message (Markdown) and send it to all confirmed subscribers.
nl_missing: Please fill in subject and message.
nl_send_confirm: Send the newsletter to all confirmed subscribers now?
backup_hint: Saves content, statistics, messages and all uploaded images as a ZIP.
autobackup_hint: Once a day a full backup is written to addon_configs/<slug>_mypage/autobackup/. How many are kept is set on the “Settings” tab (0 = off). Use 📌 to keep a backup so the daily rotation cannot remove it (3 at most).
autobackup_off: Automatic backups are disabled in the add-on options.
revisions_hint: Before every change the previous state of the site content is saved. That lets you bring back an accidentally deleted text without restoring a whole backup. What is saved is the complete state of the site: posts, pages, projects, library, forms, sections, design — and therefore the module switches too. Restoring a version puts blog, library or travel blog back the way they stood at the time. Members, messages, travel blog content, statistics and the settings live in separate files and stay untouched. How many versions are kept is set in the “Settings” tab (0 = off). Use 📌 to keep a version: it is never cleaned up automatically and does not count against the retention — handy for the starting state before a big rebuild.
revisions_off: Earlier versions are switched off (“Settings” tab, versions kept set to 0).
revisions_confirm_restore: Really restore this version? The current site content will be replaced — the current state is saved as a version first.
pin_limit: Limit for kept versions reached — release one first.
snip_hint: This is how Google builds the result from your fields. Without your own text the same fallback applies as on the site: SEO description → text excerpt → home page description. Google shortens overlong entries — the counters show where.
snip_desc_empty: No description — Google will pick a passage from the text itself.
seo_ai_title: Writes an SEO description from the text — in the language selected here.
seo_ai_nosrc: No text for the AI to summarise.
seo_list_hint: Every item with its own SEO field in one place. Where none is set, the line below shows what Google gets today — usually the start of the text. Edits happen right here; they are stored with “Save descriptions”.
seo_list_ai_all_confirm: Have a description written for {n} items? This uses AI quota.
seo_list_unsaved: There are unsaved changes. Reload anyway?
confirm_restore: Restore backup? Existing content will be overwritten.
stat_top_pages_hint: Most visited pages from recent visits (bots excluded).
legal_hint_impressum: Required in Germany for non-private sites (§5 DDG). Generate a template, e.g. with the e-recht24.de imprint generator, and paste it here.
legal_hint_privacy: Required by Art. 13 GDPR — among other things because of the visitor log (IP addresses). Generate a template, e.g. with datenschutz-generator.de (free for individuals), and paste it here.
legal_footer_hint: Once text is entered, the links appear automatically in the footer of the public page (/impressum and /datenschutz). Empty pages are not linked.
avatar_hint: Recommended: square image, at least 256×256 px.
gh_already: already imported — re-check to refresh desc/language/tags (+README if checked)
error_select: Please select at least one repo.
no_projects_admin: No projects yet — create one or import from GitHub.
freetext_hint: Freely designed section: text and images via the Markdown editor. Heading optional — if left empty, no heading is shown.
poll_hint: One question with 2–5 answer options on the homepage. Members vote with their account, guests anonymously via cookie — one vote each, changeable at any time.
poll_reset_hint: Deletes all votes cast — useful when asking a new question.
lb_intro: Who has beaten the AI most often? Overall standings and per-game rankings — all completed games count.
lb_empty: No completed games yet — the ranking fills up with the first game played.
ach_first_win_desc: Won a game against the AI
ach_allrounder_desc: Played every game at least once
ach_first_dm_desc: Sent a message to a member
tips_hint: Collect several tips — one is shown automatically on the homepage. Markdown allowed.
tips_rotation_hint: With “Random: No” the tips run in order; with “Yes” a random (but identical for all visitors) tip is chosen per day/week.
tips_import_hint: Paste a JSON array (e.g. [{"text_de":"…","text_en":"…"}]). The tips are appended to the list — remember to save afterwards.
tips_import_invalid: Invalid JSON or no tips found.
preview_banner: Preview — this is how the post will look once published (not yet visible to visitors).
presets_hint: One click sets mode, accent color, font and layout to a ready-made style. The fields below are filled — click “Save” to apply the template. Your custom CSS stays untouched.
banner_hint: A slim notice bar at the very top of all public pages (e.g. “Summer party on Jul 12!”). Color = accent color.
banner_text_ph: e.g. Summer party on Jul 12 — sign up now!
ai_address_hint: Applies to everything the AI writes: SEO descriptions, texts from the AI studio and travel reports. Without a setting the model defaults to the formal address in German. English versions stay with the neutral “you”.
design_find_ph: Find an option — e.g. comments, font, feed
design_save_hint: Saves every section of this tab, collapsed ones included.
field_nav_hint: Header jump links to the sections that exist (Projects, Photos …).
content_acc_hint: Click a section to expand it. “Save” at the bottom stores all sections.
content_dnd_hint: Drag the handle (⠿) to change the order on the homepage; use the eye 👁 to hide a section (content is kept). Both are saved instantly.
section_edit_elsewhere: This section is edited in its own tab – here you can only set its position on the homepage.
services_hint: Your offers or services – with an optional icon (emoji) and price.
testimonials_hint: Client quotes / recommendations with name, role and optional photo.
team_hint: People with photo, role and a short description.
events_hint: Upcoming dates with date, location and optional link.
facts_hint: Key figures in a row: members, years, projects, opening days. The figure may be text — “500+”, “24/7” and “~3M” all work. Symbol optional.
partners_hint: Logos of partners, sponsors or clients. Without a logo the name is shown. All logos are scaled to the same height so none overpowers the others.
videos_hint: YouTube or Vimeo addresses. The video only loads on click — until then no third-party script runs on the page. Addresses that are not recognised are dropped when saving.
downloads_hint: PDFs to download: statutes, price list, menu, forms. The file is always delivered as a download, never opened in the browser. If the section is members-only, so are the files.
location_hint: Address, opening hours and an optional map (privacy-friendly, OpenStreetMap).
location_coords_hint: For the map. On openstreetmap.org right-click → “Show address” gives the values.
booking_hint: Optional: link to Calendly, Cal.com etc. Shown as a button next to the support button.
preview_hint: The admin renders the page itself — so neither the reverse proxy’s frame protection nor the ingress gets in the way. Scripts do not run in the preview; every click opens the real page in a new tab.
preview_blocked: The preview could not be built. Check the log for a message from the public site; “Open in new tab” shows whether the site is running at all.
stat_traffic_hint: What MyPage served, visitors and bots separately. Measured at the server — an upstream reverse proxy compresses on its own and adds TLS, so the figures on the wire differ.
crawler_none: No search-engine crawler in the current log yet.
pdf_import_hint: Legal texts from generators such as e-Recht24 can be taken straight from the PDF — headings, lists and links are preserved. You get a preview before anything is applied, and the text stays fully editable afterwards. Nothing is stored until you press Save.
legal_too_long: The text was longer than {n} characters and was stored shortened. Please shorten it and save again.
pdf_import_preview: How it will look on the page
pdf_src_layout: structure guessed from the page layout
pdf_warn_layout: This PDF carries no embedded source, so headings and bold text were guessed from font size and weight. Please check the preview.
pdf_warn_truncated: The text was very long and has been shortened.
pdf_warn_kind: This PDF looks like a different legal text than the field you picked.
pdf_warn_lang: This PDF looks like a different language than the field you picked.
pdf_err_not_pdf: That is not a PDF file.
pdf_err_too_large: The file is too large (20 MB maximum).
pdf_err_no_text: No text could be read from this PDF — most likely a scan without text recognition.
pdf_err_too_many_pages: The PDF has too many pages.
pdf_err_unreadable: The PDF could not be read.
ex_intro: A session is a run of hits from the same address with the same browser signature, no more than 30 minutes apart. All times are add-on local time.
ex_scanners: {n} sessions without any browser traits were hidden (one request, no referrer, no language) — scanners, not visitors. Turn on the bot switch above to see them again.
ex_seq_none: No sequence occurs more than once yet.
ex_returning_hint: Same address and same browser signature on at least two different days.
ex_journey_last: The last page has no time on page — there is no record of when someone leaves.
ex_stale_text: You can still browse the months already recorded, but new hits are no longer being written.
ex_off_text: The explorer reads the monthly files under visits/. That archive is still switched off, so there is nothing to show. From the moment you switch it on, every hit is recorded — nothing can be recovered retroactively.
ex_off_done: Switched on. The explorer fills up once the first visitors arrive.
ex_off_option: Switched on via the add-on option visit_file_log.
ex_empty_month: No hits recorded for this month yet.
ex_truncated: Very large file — only the most recent lines were evaluated.
slug_changed: The address you entered was already taken. Saved as “{slug}” — that is where the entry can be found.

gp_played_hint: Shows the 📋 button in the top bar

gj_ai_picks: The AI is picking a tile …
gj_buzz_hint: Hit it faster than the AI – or let it pass.

gj_final_wager_prompt: Secretly wager on the final clue.

ggr_evt_extra_life_skip: {player} — Already has an extra life, spin again!

member_quota_near: Your storage is more than 80% full.
member_quota_full: Your storage is almost full — please delete old files.
weekly_review_hint: Sends a recap of the previous week every Monday (views, visitors, top page, new members and messages) as a Home Assistant notification — and, if SMTP is set up, also by email.
weekly_review_hint_docker: Sends a summary of the previous week (views, visitors, top page, new members and messages) by e-mail every Monday. SMTP has to be configured for it.
member_export_hint: Download all data stored for your account (account details, files, comments, sent messages).
member_delete_hint: Permanently deletes your account and all your files. Enter your password to confirm.
member_delete_confirm: Really delete your account and all files permanently?
member_account_deleted: Your account and all data have been deleted. Sorry to see you go!
library_settings_hint: Name and intro of the collection. Empty name = “Library”. That way the same collection can also be called “Travel guides”, “Recipes” or “Manuals”.
library_layout_hint: Applies to the teaser on the home page only, not to the full overview. “Large cards” take the most space, “collapsed row” the least.
library_layout_overlay: Image tiles with title on the image
library_layout_mini: Small cards with image on the left
library_layout_list: List — all entries below each other
library_cats_hint: Freely chosen categories (e.g. Travel, Cooking, Tech). Drag to reorder.
library_cat_icon_hint: Optional — shown before the category name.
library_confirm_del_cat: Really delete this category? Entries are kept (without a category).
library_entries_hint: An entry is a Markdown text with an optional PDF. Drag to reorder.
library_pdf_hint_none: Visitors can still save the page as a PDF via “Print”.
library_pdf_hint_generated: On save, a PDF is generated from the Markdown text and offered for download.
library_pdf_hint_unavailable: PDF generation is not available on this system — visitors can save the page as a PDF via “Print”.
library_pdf_hint_upload: Your own PDF file (max. 25 MB), offered as a download.
ai_img_prompt_hint: Pre-filled from title, category, tags and summary — edit as you like. The generated image is set as the cover right away; the entry itself is only stored when you click “Save”.
ai_img_running: Generating image … (this can take up to a minute)
ai_img_done: Image generated and set as the cover.
ai_img_err_refused: The AI declined the request. Please adjust the description.
ai_img_err_limit: Too many image requests in a short time — please try again later.
ai_img_err_nokey: No Gemini API key configured in the app options.
ai_img_prompt_title: Cover image for an article titled “{v}”.
ai_img_prompt_style: Style: modern, calm, high quality, photorealistic, no text or lettering in the image.
ai_settings_hint: Models are queried live from Google. What you set here overrides the add-on options — switching models needs no restart.
ai_translate_hint: Applies to every 🌐 button in the admin. If Gemini fails, MyMemory takes over automatically.
ai_quota: Quota this hour: {iu}/{im} images · {tu}/{tm} text requests
ai_img_hint: Generated images are only held temporarily on the server. Only “Save” moves them into your uploads — flagged as AI generated. Unconfirmed drafts expire after an hour.
ai_img_prompt_ph: What should be in the picture? The more specific, the better.
ai_img_ref_hint: With a reference the image is varied instead of invented from scratch. Only your own uploads can be used.
ai_img_ready: {n} draft(s) generated — pick one and save it.
ai_style_photo_txt: Style: photorealistic, natural light, high sharpness.
ai_style_illu_txt: Style: hand-drawn illustration with clean outlines.
ai_style_flat_txt: Style: flat vector art, reduced colour palette, geometric.
ai_style_render3d_txt: Style: 3D render, soft studio light, matte surfaces.
ai_style_water_txt: Style: watercolour, soft transitions, visible paper texture.
ai_style_retro_txt: Style: 1970s retro, grainy texture, warm muted colours.
ai_err_refused: The AI declined the request. Please adjust the description.
ai_err_limit: Hourly quota used up — please try again later.
ai_err_nokey: No Gemini API key configured in the add-on options.
ai_err_ref: The reference image could not be found.
ai_txt_hint: Produces title, SEO description, body text and tags — in German and English in a single pass if you want.
ai_txt_topic_ph: What is it about? Bullet points are enough — the more facts, the less the AI invents.
ai_txt_err_topic: Please enter a topic or some notes.
ai_to_post_hint: Opens the post dialog as a draft. Saving happens there.
ai_draft_name_ph: Leave empty — the title is used instead
ai_draft_hint: Stores inputs and result in the add-on folder (ai_drafts.json) — included in the backup.
ai_draft_loaded: Open: “{v}” — saving overwrites this draft. “Detach” creates a new one on the next save.
ai_draft_err_empty: There is no text to save yet.
ai_drafts_hint: “Open” loads inputs and text back into the studio — even after a restart.
alts_hint: An image without alternative text does not exist for screen readers and says nothing to search engines. The text belongs to the file and applies everywhere it is used. In Markdown it only fills in where you wrote none: ![your own text](…) always wins.
alts_capped: {n} images match — the first 100 are listed here.
alts_ai_all_confirm: Generate alternative text for {n} images? That costs {n} text requests and counts towards the hourly limit.
alts_ai_one_done: Alternative text is in the field — still needs saving.
tr_hint: Free text or an existing entry, in both directions. Nothing is written back — the result sits below, ready to copy.
tr_source: Where does the text come from? Pick an entry and a field, then “Load”. The body text is preselected — title and SEO description are in the field list.
tr_input_ph: Paste text, or load an entry above …
tr_ready: Translated — please give it a quick read.
tr_provider: Translating via: {v}. Change it in the settings above.
tr_err_empty: There is no text to translate yet.
tr_err_source_empty: That entry has nothing in this language yet.
tr_err_nothing_copy: There is no translation to copy yet.
ai_import: Load existing text into the studio
ai_import_hint: Fills the result fields from an existing post, project or library entry — to revise, translate or add an SEO description. The original stays untouched until you write it back with “Use as …”.
ai_prompt_name_ph: Leave empty — the first words are used
ai_prompts_hint: Stores description, count, aspect ratio and reference image in ai_prompts.json — included in the backup. The same name overwrites the entry.
ai_prompt_loaded: Prompt loaded — hit Generate to run it.
ai_est_text: ≈ ${v} for this run — a rough estimate assuming about {w} words of output. Billing goes by tokens, which nobody knows in advance.
ai_est_images: ≈ ${v} for {n} image(s) — list price per 1K image; larger resolutions cost more.
ai_est_none: No price on file for this model — add one under “Usage and cost”.
ai_img_ratio_hint: Applies to the next run. The permanent default is saved in the settings above.
ai_vary_hint: Uses this image as the reference and generates a variation right away.
ai_undo_done: Previous version restored — the same button brings it back.
ai_instructions_ph: e.g.: Address readers informally. No emoji. Always spell the product name "MyPage".
ai_instructions_hint: Applies to every text from the studio, revisions included. Up to 800 characters; leave empty to switch it off.
ai_revise_hint: Takes the text from the fields above and returns a changed version. Only the selected language is regenerated — that halves the cost.
ai_revise_note_ph: What should change? e.g.: trim the intro, add a Home Assistant example
ai_revise_ready: Revised version is in the fields.
ai_revise_err_empty: There is no text to revise yet.
ai_revise_err_lang: There is no text in that language yet.
ai_to_seo_done: SEO description filled in — still needs saving on the Design tab.
ai_reset_confirm_text: Clear the form and start over? Saved drafts are kept.
ai_reset_confirm_img: Clear the inputs? Images already generated stay.
ai_results_info: {n} drafts in this session, {k} of them saved. Unsaved ones expire after an hour and are gone once you reload the page.
ai_delete_in_use: The image is still in use — replace it there first, then delete.
logo_hint: Produces complete logo sets at exact pixel sizes — PNG with a transparent background, with no AI marking burnt into the image (it goes into the file's text fields and prompt.txt). They are NOT stored with the uploads but in a folder of their own inside the add-on configuration folder.
logo_prompt_ph: What should the logo show? Few, clear shapes work best as an icon.
logo_running: Generating logo drafts … (may take a minute)
logo_style_flat_txt: Style: flat vector logo, few shapes, clean geometry, no gradients.
logo_style_line_txt: Style: line-art logo with even stroke width, no filled areas.
logo_style_mascot_txt: Style: friendly mascot, rounded shapes, few colours.
logo_style_mono_txt: Style: monogram of one or two letters, bold typeface, nothing else.
logo_style_emblem_txt: Style: emblem inside a circle or crest, symmetrical, clear outline.
logo_style_glassy_txt: Style: soft gradient, glassy sheen, modern app look.
logo_style_ha_txt: Style: rounded square as the base shape with one symbol inside and a single accent colour — matching a Home Assistant add-on.
logo_targets_hint: The AI only delivers an aspect ratio. MyPage does the sizing: generate once as a square, then crop and fit it for every target.
logo_slug_hint: Becomes the folder name. Lower-case letters, digits, - and _ only. An existing set is added to.
logo_custom_hint: In addition to the presets. 16 to 4096 pixels.
logo_cutout_hint: Removes the uniform background touching the image edge and makes it transparent. Enclosed areas inside the motif stay as they are. Works well for flat logos, less so for gradients and photos.
logo_tolerance: How similar may the background be?
logo_tol_wide: Very generous — may eat into the motif
logo_import_hint: Without AI: bring an existing image into the same sizes. The bigger the source, the better — anything smaller than the largest target gets upscaled and turns blurry.
logo_rerender_hint: Generates the formats selected above again from source.png — without a new AI call.
logo_delete_confirm: Delete the logo set “{v}” with all its files?
logo_err_slug: Please enter a name for the set (lower-case letters, digits, - and _).
logo_err_targets: Please choose at least one target format.
logo_err_many: There are already a lot of logo sets — please delete some first.
logo_err_render: The image could not be processed.
logo_err_source: This set has no source.png — please create it again.
ai_usage_hint: Token counts come straight from Google's responses, costs are calculated from stored list prices in US dollars. It stays an estimate: free tiers, rounding and price changes are unknown to the add-on.
ai_usage_empty: Nothing generated in this month yet.
ai_prices_hint: List prices are stored for known models — they show greyed out as placeholders and are used in the calculation without you doing anything. Only fill in a value where no placeholder appears or your plan differs. All figures in US dollars, the way Google states them.
img_ai_hint: AI-generated images always carry the note “AI generated” — regardless of this setting.
library_protect_hint: Burns the watermark into cover images and images inside library entries — including the generated PDF. Same setting as for the photo albums: a change here applies there as well. Empty text field = “© your-domain.com”.
cleanup_pdf_hint: Removes library PDFs that no longer belong to any entry. Normally the library cleans up after itself; what remains are the cases that slip past — an aborted render, or a restore from a backup with fewer entries.
cleanup_pdf_confirm: Permanently delete {n} unused PDF file(s) ({mb} MB)?
ai_prices_fetch_hint: Queries Google Cloud's price catalogue and fills in the matches above — nothing is stored until you click “Save”. Google describes its items in prose, so mapping them to a model is guesswork: please look before you accept.
ai_prices_fetch_running: Querying the price catalogue … (this can take a minute)
ai_prices_fetched: {n} prices filled in — please check and save.
ai_prices_fetch_disabled: The “Cloud Billing API” is not enabled in the project this key belongs to.
ai_prices_fetch_key: The price-lookup key was rejected — invalid or restricted to other services.
ai_prices_fetch_failed: The price catalogue could not be reached.
ai_prices_fetch_noservice: No Gemini service found in the price catalogue ({n} services read).
ai_prices_fetch_nomatch: Searched: {s} — {n} items read, but no description contains a model name. Please enter the prices by hand.
ai_err_model: The configured model “{v}” does not exist at Google (any more). Please pick another one under Settings above and save.
files_hint: All uploaded images and the library PDFs. Left-clicking an image opens its management dialog (name, folder, tags, usage, replace); the box in the top right selects it for moving. PDFs open in a new tab. Right-click deletes after confirmation. Files still in use cannot be deleted — use “Replace” instead.
files_docs_hidden: Hidden while the AI filter is on — PDFs carry no AI marker.
media_search_ph: Search: name, tag, alt text, usage
media_click_hint: click to manage, right-click to delete
media_replace_confirm: The image will be replaced by the file you pick. The file name stays, so it changes everywhere at once. Continue?
media_replaced: Replaced. Browsers may keep showing the old version for up to a day — Ctrl+Shift+R helps.
files_del_used_confirm: This file is still in use, so deleting it will most likely be refused. Try anyway?
ai_err_empty: The AI returned no image. Usually the description was judged not permissible without being reported as a refusal — please rephrase it.
trav_trips_hint: Writing style and language are set once per trip and then apply to every daily report. Click a trip to see its days.
trav_del_trip_confirm: Delete trip “{v}” with all its days?
trav_settings_hint: Apply to every daily report of this trip — no need to set them per day.
trav_inc_practical: Mention practical details (travel, duration, opening hours)
trav_days_hint: One day = one report. Only day number and date are required, everything else may stay empty.
trav_no_report_yet: No report generated yet. Click “Create travel report” below.
trav_generating: Writing the travel report … (this can take a minute)
trav_revise_hint: Takes the report from the fields below and returns it changed — your own edits survive, unlike a fresh generation. “Longer” sends the day's data along so nothing gets invented.
trav_revise_note_ph: What should be different? e.g. shorten the intro, more about dinner
trav_revised: The revised version is in the fields.
trav_revise_err_empty: There is no report in this language to revise yet.
trav_weather_entity_hint: Every weather.* entity in your installation is offered here. Note: an entity measures where it was set up — usually at home. For a destination abroad, create a weather entity for that place in Home Assistant first.
trav_weather_entity_gone: no longer exists in Home Assistant
trav_weather_unmapped: Condition “{v}” has no match in the form, please pick one yourself.
trav_weather_err_date: Enter a date in the “Day & place” step first.
trav_weather_err_history: Home Assistant has nothing stored for that day any more. History reaches back ten days by default.
trav_weather_err_future: There is no weather for a day in the future yet.
trav_weather_err_entity: That entity no longer exists in Home Assistant — please pick a new one in the trip dialog.
trav_recap_hint: The text about the whole trip — it sits above the list of days in public. It is written from the finished daily reports; days without a report stay out.
trav_recap_days: {n} days with a finished report go into the recap.
trav_recap_no_days: No day has a finished report yet — there is nothing to write a recap from.
trav_recap_none_yet: No recap yet. “Create recap” writes it.
trav_recap_publish_hint: Without the tick it stays a draft. The trip page then shows just the list of days, as before.
trav_recap_overwrite: There is already a recap. Creating a new one overwrites it along with your edits. Continue?
trav_recap_running: Writing the recap … (this can take a minute)
trav_prompt_show: Show the prompt of the last run ({n} characters)
trav_exif_no_place: There is no place name for these coordinates.
trav_exif_geo_failed: The place service (OpenStreetMap) did not answer.
trav_need_content: Please add at least one experience or a summary of the day.
trav_draft_restore: There is an unsaved draft for this day. Restore it?
trav_weather_hint: Without this tick the AI leaves the weather out of the report.
trav_publish_hint: Only a ticked box puts the day online. Without a report it stays hidden even when ticked — a page with a date and no text helps nobody.
trav_slug_hint: Part of the web address: /reiseblog/this-part. Leave empty to derive it from the name. Once assigned it stays put so shared links keep working.
trav_public_intro: Notes from the road — one day at a time.
trav_photo_caption_hint: Leave empty to use the caption written by the AI. Photos without a note get none from the AI — you can add one here.
travel_enabled_hint: Turns the travel blog on. NO takes it out of service entirely: section, nav entries and the pages under /reise/… are gone, and so are the Travel blog tab and the section under Content. Stored trips and days are left untouched and come back unchanged when you switch it on. YES is enough for preparing — as long as no day is published, the website shows nothing.
forms_enabled_hint: Turns the forms on. NO takes them out of service entirely: section, nav entries and the pages under /formular/… are gone, and so are the Forms tab and the section under Content. Existing forms and received answers are left untouched. YES is enough for preparing — a form without its own "active" switch never goes live.
blog_enabled_hint: Turns the blog on. NO takes it out of service entirely: no section on the home page, no nav entry, /blog and the post pages answer with 404, nothing in the sitemap, RSS feed, search or static export — and the Blog tab and its card under Content go away too. Posts and subscribers are left untouched. To prepare, switch to YES, fill things in, switch back. If the newsletter is on, the tab stays for managing it.
library_enabled_hint: Turns the library on. NO takes it out of service entirely: no section, no nav entry, /bibliothek, its entries and their PDFs answer with 404, nothing in the sitemap, feed, search or static export — and the Library tab and its card under Content go away too. Entries and PDFs are left untouched. To prepare, switch to YES for a while.
projects_enabled_hint: Turns the projects on. NO takes them out of service entirely: no section, no nav entry, the detail pages under /p/… answer with 404, nothing in the sitemap, feed, search or static export — and the Projects tab including the GitHub import, plus its card under Content, go away too. Existing projects are left untouched. To prepare, switch to YES for a while.
default_lang_hint: Which language an address serves without any extra hint. Visitors can switch at any time and the choice is remembered. With “Automatic” the browser's language setting decides — but then the same address serves different content per visitor, and search engines, which send no language setting, get the English version. For a German domain, better to fix it to German.
feed_lang_hint: The feed at /feed.xml always delivers this language. Deliberately fixed: a feed reader fetches the same address for all of its users and usually sends no language header at all. Use ?lang=de or ?lang=en to fetch the other version.
feed_extra_hint: Blog posts and published travel days are always in the feed. Projects and library entries rarely change and would flood it once with old material when switched on — hence the separate switches. Projects only appear if they have a detail page, and without a date, so they sort last.
feed_members_only: This content is for members only. Please sign in on the website to read it.
trav_no_trip_selected: No trip selected — please click a trip on the left.
trav_save_offline: Not saved: the server could not be reached. The dialog stays open and your input is stored locally — please press Save again in a moment.
trav_save_session: Not saved: your session has expired. Please sign in again in a second tab, then save here once more.
nf_probe_title: Looking for other software (WordPress, .env, GraphQL) — none of that exists here, and there is nothing to fix.
